enchantments.tooltip: Spike-Studded: This item is reinforced with metal studs that improve your unarmed strikes. Your unarmed attacks do an additional 1 to 4 piercing damage.
Strength +5: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +5 Enhancement bonus to Strength.

Glass Jaw Strike: While wearing this item, when you roll a 20 on an unarmed attack, you will deal a tremendous blow to your target that will daze it (as the Sap ability) and may knock it down as well.

children.tooltip: Sneak Attack Bonus +4 : Provides a +4 Enhancement modifier to your attack bonus and a +6 Enhancement bonus to damage for any attack that would qualify as a Sneak Attack, even if the wielder is not a Rogue.
